nc92cf07d96.headline: Azerbaijan discusses expansion of innovative payment services with SWIFT
nc92cf07d96.summary: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan is discussing expansion of innovative payment services with SWIFT. The talks are aimed at supporting payment system functioning and banking stability.
nc92cf07d96.why: SWIFT is the global messaging network that banks use for cross-border payments. Changes to payment infrastructure affect how banks and businesses transfer money internationally.

ncc0ef55baa.why: The central bank governor oversees monetary policy and the currency peg in Lebanon. Leadership uncertainty at the central bank affects confidence in Lebanon's financial system.

n18e22b6555.headline: UK will avoid recession in 2023 – IMF

n6b9ade6dc9.summary: The Bank of England admitted it made errors in its UK inflation forecasts. Governor Andrew Bailey insisted inflation has turned the corner, ahead of official figures due Wednesday.
n6b9ade6dc9.why: The Bank of England sets UK interest rates, which affect gilt yields, sterling and borrowing costs. Its inflation forecasts guide monetary policy decisions.

n5fc37204ff.why: ECOWAS is the West African regional economic and political bloc. Its institutional cooperation can influence regional governance.

n5a03ff4e67.summary: The UAE Central Bank has dissolved the board of directors of an insurance company. A newly appointed committee will carry out business on the company's behalf.
n5a03ff4e67.why: The Central Bank of the UAE regulates the country's insurers and banks, and board interventions signal supervisory action that affects policyholders and investors in the sector.
